# Appendix A – Status of Structures Assessed in the Field {-}

## Non-actionable Barriers {-}

No non-actionable barriers were identified through the implementation of this WCRP as of July 2026.


## Data-deficient Barriers {-}

Table X: Structures in Berland and Wildhay watersheds that have been assessed for fish passage for cold-water salmonids as of July 2026, but either require an additional in-depth fish-passage assessment to confirm the passability status or a habitat assessment to confirm upstream habitat values.
